content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

- **§ 2.1 (p0012):** expressly states "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies," with fees only for Services ordered under an executed Order Form, and declining to place further orders is not a breach or shortfall.
- **§ 7.1 (p0026):** blocks any Vendor-imposed "minimum-use" or similar charge not identified in the Order Form — closing the Order Form-level back door the planner flagged.
- **§ 12.3 (p0050):** confirms Customer has made no minimum-volume (or exclusivity/MFC) commitment.

The only "shortfall" language in the document (§§ 22.2–22.3) relates to audited underpayments, not committed volumes, and no volume caps on Customer usage appear. The 180-day renewal notice in § 8.2 is an auto-renewal point handled under a separate rule, not a take-or-pay commitment.
